title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**
----------------

Are you an early-career software engineer who cares about writing good code and wants to learn from experienced engineers while building systems that matter?

Join us at FTSE Russell! We’re building a team of engineers passionate about software craftsmanship, quality, and continuous improvement. As an Associate Software Engineer, you’ll contribute to the software that powers indices trusted by financial institutions worldwide, working alongside experienced engineers who will help you develop your technical skills and engineering judgement.

We build primarily in Python, so experience with Python is valuable — but we’re equally interested in strong programming fundamentals and your ability to learn. If you’ve worked with Java, C#, C, C++, Scala, Go, Rust, or another modern programming language and are motivated to develop your Python skills, we’d like to hear from you.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll write, test, review, and improve production software as part of an experienced engineering team. You’ll learn how well-designed software is built and operated in practice — from clean code and automated testing to APIs, databases, cloud services, observability, and production support.

You won’t be expected to know everything from day one. We’re looking for engineers with solid foundations, curiosity, and the willingness to learn, ask questions, take feedback, and gradually take ownership of increasingly complex work.

If you’re excited about developing as a software engineer while building systems used in global financial markets, we’d love to meet you.

  
  

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING**
------------------------

We’re building the next-generation index data platform at FTSE Russell — and you’ll help us build it:

* Writing clean, maintainable production code, primarily in Python, with guidance and support from more experienced engineers
* Building and enhancing software components, services, APIs, and shared libraries as part of a collaborative engineering team
* Writing automated tests and learning how to build software that is reliable, secure, and easy to maintain
* Participating in code reviews — learning from feedback on your own code and gradually developing the skills to review the work of others
* Investigating bugs and production issues, understanding root causes, and implementing well-tested fixes
* Working with relational databases such as Aurora PostgreSQL, learning good practices around data modelling, queries, and schema evolution
* Developing software running on AWS using technologies such as Lambda, containerised services, object storage, and other managed AWS services
* Contributing to data-intensive applications that process significant volumes of financial and index data
* Using CI/CD pipelines and development tooling to build, test, and deploy software safely
* Learning how observability, logging, monitoring, and quality controls help us operate reliable production systems
* Working closely with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver useful solutions
* Taking part in design discussions and learning how experienced engineers evaluate technical options and trade-offs
* Building knowledge of financial indices and understanding how the software you develop supports our customers
* Continuously developing your engineering skills through hands-on work, feedback, pairing, and knowledge sharing
  

  

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**
---------------------

Essential — we’re looking for strong foundations and potential:

* A foundation in software development gained through professional experience, internships, graduate programmes, university projects, open-source contributions, or substantial personal projects
* Programming experience in Python or another modern language such as Java, C#, C, C++, Scala, Go, or Rust, together with a willingness to develop strong Python skills
* Understanding of core software engineering concepts such as functions, classes, data structures, APIs, error handling, and automated testing
* An interest in writing readable, maintainable code rather than simply making something work
* Basic understanding of software development practices such as version control, code review, testing, and debugging
* Familiarity with Git or another source control system
* Basic knowledge of relational databases and SQL
* An analytical approach to problem solving and the ability to break problems into smaller, manageable pieces
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and engineering practices
* Openness to feedback and an interest in learning from more experienced engineers
* Good communication skills and the confidence to ask questions when something is unclear
* A collaborative mindset — you enjoy solving problems with others and contributing to a supportive engineering environment

We don’t expect Associate Engineers to arrive knowing our entire technology stack. Strong programming fundamentals, evidence that you enjoy building software, and the ability to learn are more important than having used every technology listed in this description.

  
  

**NICE TO HAVES**
-----------------

Beneficial, but definitely not required:

* Experience building applications, APIs, services, or libraries in Python
* Familiarity with Python development practices such as type hints, pytest, linters, and dependency management
* Exposure to AWS or another public cloud platform
* Experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database
* Understanding of REST APIs and distributed or service-based architectures
* Experience with Docker or containerised applications
* Familiarity with CI/CD tooling such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
* Exposure to infrastructure as code such as Terraform or AWS CDK
* Experience with data processing, ETL, or data-intensive applications
* Exposure to Pandas, Apache Spark / PySpark, or similar data-processing technologies
* Familiarity with object storage, data lakes, or technologies such as Apache Iceberg
* Contributions to open-source projects or personal software projects you can talk us through
* Experience in financial markets, financial data, or investment analytics
* An interest in financial markets and a willingness to learn the index domain

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement. This role is an opportunity to build strong software engineering foundations, learn from experienced engineers, and gradually take on greater technical responsibility while contributing to software used across global financial markets.

  
  
  
  

**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**

**Career Stage:**

Associate

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

title: Lead Business Process Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
===============

We are seeking an experienced Lead Business Process Analyst to drive business process transformation and platform strategy across the enterprise case management and workflow platform ecosystem. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams to ensure that platform solutions align with organizational objectives and deliver measurable business value. The Lead Business Process Analyst will provide leadership in process design, requirement management, governance, solution planning, and organizational change initiatives, influencing decision making at multiple levels of the organization while driving continuous improvement and adoption of platform capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead end-to-end business process analysis initiatives across products including ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, HRSD, FSM, SPM, and custom applications.
* Partner with executive stakeholders, process owners, and business leaders to define strategic roadmaps and transformation initiatives.
* Facilitate workshops to identify business challenges, opportunities, process gaps, and optimization strategies.
* Define current-state and future-state processes, operating models, and business capability maps.
* Translate business objectives into scalable platform solutions and actionable requirements.
* Establish and maintain process governance, standards, and best practices across platform implementations.
* Lead requirement elicitation, prioritization, documentation, and validation activities.
* Collaborate with platform architects, product owners, developers, and QA teams to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Evaluate and challenge existing business processes to drive standardization, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Conduct impact assessments, process maturity evaluations, and business value realization reviews.
* Drive organizational change management activities, stakeholder engagement, training strategies, and adoption planning.
* Mentor Senior Business Process Analysts and Business Analysts while promoting best practices across the team.
* Support portfolio planning, business case development, and executive presentations.
* Establish KPIs and metrics to measure process effectiveness, platform adoption, and business outcomes.
* Provide leadership during large-scale transformation programs and enterprise platform deployments.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10 or more years of overall business analysis and process transformation experience.
* 5 or more years of hands on experience working within a case management and workflow platform ecosystem.
* Extensive experience leading requirements gathering and business process workshops.
* Strong knowledge of platform modules such as ITSM, ITAM, CSM, HRSD, SPM, FSM, and integrations.
* Proven experience leading large enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, SAFe, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Experience collaborating with executives, directors, product owners, architects, and technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive consensus across complex organizations.
* Experience defining process governance models and business operating procedures.
* Excellent analytical, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Certified System Administrator level platform certification.
* Certified Implementation Specialist certification or certifications relevant to the platform.
* Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP).
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt.
* SAFe Agilist or other Agile certifications.
* Experience with enterprise-scale platform transformation programs.
* Experience in global organizations supporting multiple business functions and regions.

**Key Competencies**
====================

* Strategic Thinking
* Business Process Transformation
* Enterprise Stakeholder Management
* Business Architecture
* Platform Expertise
* Process Governance
* Change Management
* Executive Communication
* Requirements Management
* Continuous Improvement
* Leadership and Mentoring
* Data-Driven Decision Making

**Success Measures**
====================

* Increased platform adoption and business value realization.
* Improved process standardization and operational efficiency.
* Successful delivery of enterprise process transformation initiatives.
* Reduction in process bottlenecks and manual effort through automation.
* Enhanced stakeholder satisfaction and platform effectiveness.
* Strong governance and alignment between business objectives and platform capabilities.

**Role Positioning**
====================

This role is positioned as a Lead-level individual contributor, often operating at the same level as a Product Owner or Solution Architect, and capable of leading multiple Senior Business Process Analysts across large enterprise platform programs and future platform initiatives.

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging**  
Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

title: Associate Director - IAM Operations and Governance
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**:

The Associate Director, IAM Operations and Governance will lead the team responsible for IAM audit controls and compliance governance across the identity estate. This hands-on role will set direction, translate strategy into an executable roadmap, assign clear ownership, remove delivery barriers and ensure commitments are completed to the required quality and timelines. The role will design and operate a modern, automated IAM control environment for SOX, GxP and other regulatory obligations, including continuous monitoring, evidence collection, control-to-evidence traceability, findings management and sustainable remediation. It will also lead the adoption of agentic AI and workflow automation to reduce manual effort, improve control effectiveness and provide audit-ready assurance.

**About the team:**

  

IAM Operations and Governance owns the control layer over GSK's identity estate: access certification, segregation of duties, identity risk reporting and the audit evidence that proves access is under control.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key initiatives:

  

* Lead the IAM controls, audit assurance and compliance governance capability, including its people, operating model, roadmap, delivery and outcomes; set clear priorities, delegate effectively and hold the team accountable for execution.
* Own the IAM control framework for SOX, GxP and other applicable regulatory and enterprise requirements, ensuring clear control objectives, ownership, frequency, procedures and accountability.
* Establish continuous controls monitoring across joiner, mover and leaver processes, access approvals, access certification, segregation of duties, privileged access, service accounts, orphaned accounts and excessive or stale access.
* Design and implement an automated control library that maps each control to its policy and regulatory requirement, systems in scope, control owner, required evidence, test procedure, exception criteria and remediation workflow.
* Apply Agentic AI and workflow automation to collect and validate evidence, detect control failures, identify missing or inconsistent artefacts, maintain traceability and initiate risk-based remediation with appropriate human oversight.
* Define safeguards for AI-enabled controls, including data protection, model governance, explainability, access restrictions, validation, audit logging, exception handling and human approval for material decisions.
* Lead internal and external IAM audits from planning through closure, ensuring that evidence is complete, accurate and timely, and serve as the principal liaison for auditors, Quality, Risk, Finance, Legal and control owners.
* Own findings, deficiencies and corrective and preventive actions, including root-cause analysis, risk assessment, accountable owners, target dates, validation of closure and prevention of recurrence.
* Define key control indicators, compliance dashboards and executive reporting covering control effectiveness, evidence completeness, exceptions, ageing, risk exposure and remediation progress.
* Partner with IAM engineering, application owners and business process owners to embed controls by design, simplify evidence production and reduce manual audit effort without weakening assurance; coordinate dependencies, resolve blockers and drive agreed actions through to completion.
* Build and lead a high-performing team through workforce planning, clear objectives, coaching, delegation, quality review and performance accountability, fostering a culture of ownership, compliance discipline, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* undefined

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in information security, technology, risk, audit or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Substantial experience in IAM governance, risk and compliance, with ownership of audit controls in a complex, highly regulated enterprise.
* Strong working knowledge of SOX IT general controls and GxP requirements as they apply to identity lifecycle management, access governance, privileged access and electronic records.
* Proven experience designing control frameworks, risk and control matrices, test procedures, evidence requirements and control-to-regulation traceability.
* Hands-on experience managing access certifications, segregation of duties, privileged access controls, identity risk monitoring, audit requests and remediation of control deficiencies.
* Demonstrated ability to automate control monitoring, evidence collection, testing and issue workflows using IAM, GRC, ITSM, analytics or orchestration platforms.
* Practical understanding of Agentic AI, including multi-step agent workflows, tool integration, retrieval-based evidence analysis, governance guardrails and human-in-the-loop decision controls.
* Proven experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams and major programmes, translating strategy into executable plans, managing priorities and dependencies, and ensuring delivery through influence across Cyber Security, Quality, Finance, Internal Audit, Risk, Legal, Technology and business functions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate control performance and compliance risk into clear executive decisions

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Advanced experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or a comparable identity governance platform, including certification, policy, role and analytics capabilities.
* Knowledge of GxP computerised system controls, data integrity principles, electronic records and signatures, validation expectations, and risk-based assurance.
* Relevant certification such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CGEIT, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, SailPoint or Saviynt platform certification.

* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.
* Typical tools and technologies: SailPoint, Saviynt, Archer, ServiceNow, Power BI.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, AI Governance, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Cloud IAM, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Control Monitoring, Database Management, Design Controls, Directory Services, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Oracle Identity and Access Management (IAM) Tools Administration, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Security Controls, System Monitors, Troubleshooting

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**The Future Begins Here**

At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.

Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

**About the role**:

The Sourcing Lead is responsible for obtaining goods and services essential for the organization’s operations. This role focuses on Value Creation and Sourcing Excellence¸ Team Leadership & Capability Development, Standardization & Process Excellence, Supplier & Risk Management, ensuring alignment with business goals and contributing to Takeda's mission.

How you will contribute:

* Set and own the multi-year sourcing strategy across the category portfolio, aligned to Takeda's enterprise priorities and patient-centric mission.

* Develop strategy and conduct negotiations with suppliers at different levels.

title: Associate, Data Scientist
description:
**Job Description:**

1. Conduct data analysis using Python and related libraries to support business and operations objectives.

2. Work with time-series data from Canary Historian and other industrial data sources — extraction, cleaning, and preprocessing.

3. Build, deploy, and maintain analytics solutions and pipelines on Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Azure ML/App Services).

4. Perform advanced data manipulation and transformation using Pandas and NumPy, including handling large, high-frequency time-series datasets.

5. Build interactive dashboards and visualizations using the Dash framework, Django, or Streamlit (and/or Plotly, Matplotlib, Seaborn).

6. Execute exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in operational data.

7. Develop and support AI-assisted analytics use cases — such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, forecasting, and trend detection — using ML models and/or AI tools (including GenAI/LLM-based tools, Azure Foundry where relevant).

8. Explore opportunities to integrate AI-driven automation into dashboards and reporting workflows to reduce manual effort.

9. Collaborate with stakeholders across manufacturing and operations teams to understand requirements and deliver analytics solutions.

10. Present analysis results and insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

11. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable Python code.

12. Troubleshoot and debug issues across Python, data pipelines, Azure services, and database environments.

13. Stay current with industry trends and best practices in data science, analytics, AI, and cloud technologies.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED :**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 1-3 years of professional experience in data science, data analytics, or a similar role.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with data analytics libraries (Pandas, NumPy, etc.).
* Hands-on knowledge or coursework/project experience with Microsoft Azure (storage, compute, data pipelines, or app deployment).
* Exposure to time-series data analysis and forecasting techniques.
* Solid understanding of statistical concepts and techniques (distributions, hypothesis testing, correlation, regression basics).
* Hands-on experience with the Dash framework, Django, or Streamlit for building interactive dashboards — able to build a working dashboard independently.
* Working understanding of AI/ML concepts and practical experience applying them to analytics problems (e.g., basic model building with Scikit-learn, or working with AI/GenAI tools, Azure Foundry and APIs).
* Curiosity and initiative to explore how AI can improve existing analytics and reporting processes.
* Familiarity with SQL and experience querying relational databases.
* Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to debug issues independently.

**OHMIUM CULTURE :**

At Ohmium, you are expected to embody and champion our core cultural values:

**Accountability**: **I own my tasks** **and execute on** **time**.

Demonstrate strong accountability by owning deliverables and decisions, ensuring timely and consistent results.

**Teamwork**: **I will not let other teams fail.**

Takes ownership beyond own team to support cross-team success and prevent failures, thereby fostering a collaborative work environment.

**Learning Mindset**: **I drive change and learn from mistakes.**

Exhibits a strong growth mindset by proactively leading meaningful change and consistently learning from experience.

**Winning Attitude**: **I compete to win.**

Showing up every day with a strong perspective, to drive results and be the BEST in Green Energy.

We are seeking a motivated and technically strong Data Science Associate to join our team. The incumbent should have hands on experience working on with real-world industrial time-series data, building and deploying analytics solutions on Azure, and developing interactive dashboards. The role involves working with data from our Remote Monitoring Command Application Software (SCADA), with Canary Historian as the primary time-series data source,and owning analytics dashboards/pipelines end-to-end — from data extraction to deployment on Microsoft Azure.

Ohmium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
